daily.title: ABC wins scoop of the year at 2026 Walkley Awards
daily.summary: The ABC has won seven gongs at this year’s Walkley Awards, including the coveted Scoop of the Year category for coverage of ASIO’s failures ahead of the Bondi terrorist attack.

daily.title: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingyas, UN court says
daily.summary: The top United Nations court has ruled that thousands of killings and widespread sexual violence by Myanmar's security forces against the Rohingya Muslim minority population in 2017 amounted to state-sponsored genocide.

daily.title: FIFA unveils Diallo and Tashima as challengers to Infantino's presidency
daily.summary: The March 2027 election will be the first time Mr Infantino faces a challenger after being re-elected without opposition in 2023.

daily.title: Trump, Xi and Putin release joint statement after historic talks
daily.summary: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese directly tells Vladimir Putin to end his war with Ukraine "now" ahead of a highly anticipated meeting between the Russian president, Donald Trump and Xi Jinping.

daily.title: Kimberley man who whipped and beat partner to death jailed for 10 years
daily.summary: The Supreme Court hears Craig Charlton Rastus viciously assaulted the woman for more than half an hour in Mowanjum, inflicting fatal injuries.

daily.title: 'Does it come with a chef?' rental price causes a stir within community
daily.summary: The $2,300-a-week asking price for a four-bedroom, two-bathroom home in Busselton has been scorned by priced-out locals, while the agent insists it is a premium property worth the money.

daily.title: Almost-forgotten Australian author uncovered in biography that just won $40K
daily.summary: Admired by Patrick White, author Elizabeth Harrower disappeared from public life in the 1970s. Susan Wyndham's biography of the author, which just won the Nib award, reasserts her place in Australian literary history.

daily.title: Sydney Marathon winner banned for three years, stripped of title
daily.summary: Peres Jepchirchir, winner of four World Marathon Major titles and the 2021 Olympic Games, joined the lengthening list of Kenyan athletes to be banned for doping after testing positive for EPO in an out-of-competition test.

daily.title: Mother, stepfather to stand trial over alleged murder of 12yo girl
daily.summary: Tiffani Scholten was found unresponsive at her Gold Coast home in 2022, with her mother and stepfather charged over her alleged murder.

daily.title: Police reveal fourth Melbourne Cup stolen as two accused appear in court
daily.summary: Two men have been charged after four Melbourne Cups and a Caulfield Cup were stolen from Melbourne racecourses.

daily.title: Swans complete AFL draft heist as Port take Cochrane with top pick
daily.summary: Dougie Cochrane becomes the AFL's newest number one draft pick, selected by Port Adelaide on a night that saw Sydney pull off a dramatic heist from under Brisbane's nose.

daily.title: Transmission line to take 'days' to fix, forcing closure of Eyre Peninsula schools
daily.summary: The main electricity transmission line to South Australia's Eyre Peninsula could take "days" to repair, the SA government has warned, amid emergency efforts to activate generators to provide back-up supply to the region.

daily.title: Gold Coast council faces court after evicting homeless man for picnic
daily.summary: The City of Gold Coast council evicted a homeless man to make way for a Father's Day picnic event in September.

daily.title: Big Build royal commission refers two witnesses for potential prosecution
daily.summary: The ABC understands Bandidos bike Joel Leavitt and BK Labour hire boss Bernard Kearney were referred over allegations they failed to answer the commission's questions.

daily.title: WA seafood industry warned it must unite or risk shrinking further
daily.summary: In the wake of the demersal fishing inquiry and ongoing challenges in the industry, the WA Fishing Industry Council has given its board a complete refresh.

daily.title: Mum urged to have twins in hospital before fatal infection, inquest told
daily.summary: A midwife has sobbed while telling a baby death inquest she advised Hunter mum against homebirth, fearing risks associated with twins.

daily.title: Rift over Darwin Port deepens as Landbridge dispute action looms
daily.summary: Anthony Albanese has suggested negotiations with Landbridge are continuing over the future of the Darwin Port lease, but the Chinese-owned company refutes that, as it pledges to continue with international legal action.

daily.title: Bugs bassist Jordan Brunoli dies after battle with cancer
daily.summary: The 31-year-old was surrounded by family and friends in Brisbane when he passed away last night.

daily.title: Government urged to drop references to 'religion' in terrorism definition
daily.summary: A proposal from the national security watchdog argues changing the terrorism definition would simplify legal processes and help prosecute terror threats.

daily.title: Ex-federal minister Sharman Stone dies after long illness

daily.title: Customers left in 'disbelief' as caravan company enters voluntary liquidation

daily.title: Springboks coach banned from match, sets up website for hotel watch-along
daily.summary: Springboks coach Rassie Erasmus has been banned from his side's clash against Ireland in Dublin this Saturday. So he has invited supporters to watch online with him in his hotel.

daily.title: Pleas for Tasmanians to wear seatbelts after 831 offences in a year
daily.summary: The Road Safety Advisory Council says there are still plenty of Tasmanians putting not just themselves, but others, at risk by not wearing a seatbelt properly, or at all.
